sources.finding: Host APIs provide mediated process, filesystem and HTTP operations; process.run completes asynchronously at process termination.
No boot-tagged native callback timestamp or counter mapping is documented in the supported API inventory.

Older public declarations: clock.now returns an asynchronous epoch-millisecond number; performance.now supplies a synchronous number without native mapping. Not the installed 2.1.295 declaration certificate.
Exact installed declarations govern over public documentation; no inference session or VM escape was used to recover missing local type files.

causalLimitation: Native marker acknowledged before a callback supplies a lower endpoint; native receipt after capture supplies an upper endpoint. A post-capture operation alone does not supply the required nearby lower endpoint for an early callback. Full intervals include scheduling, startup and queue waits.
minimumCapability: Provider-supported engine-origin native before-dispatch stamp or a vendor-supported finite native clock/rate/precision mapping for installed performance.now. Native DOM acknowledgement can provide the upper endpoint; helper entry cannot substitute for observer callback capture.
ownerDecision: Retain callback-entry capture and require that native provider capability, or explicitly commission a separate measurement-contract amendment if it cannot be obtained. No endpoint shift or criterion waiver is applied.
